content.text: What is the weather in Paris and in Tokyo right now? Call get_weather once per city, both in one turn, then answer in one sentence that also gives the difference of the two temperatures in Fahrenheit and how many primes lie below the sum of the two wind speeds.

thoughts.0: We need weather Paris and Tokyo. Both in one turn.
Paris 14C = 57.2F; Tokyo 21C = 69.8F. Difference = 12.6F. Sum wind = 25 kph. Primes below 25: 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23 = 9 primes.

content.text: In Paris it's 14 °C with light rain and in Tokyo it's 21 °C and clear — a temperature difference of 12.6 °F — and since the two wind speeds sum to 25 kph, 9 primes lie below that total.
